_: How a field battle plays (army_field.gd, army_melee.gd and combat.gd read it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). kickLands: a kick's chance to land. dodge: the chance a blow that misses is a dodge rather than a parry. kickOdds: how often a swordsman kicks instead of cutting. floored: the chance a heavy blow that doesn't kill knocks a man down. field: the massed battle of two hosts (army_field.gd on army.gd's regiments): gap, the lines' middles apart when they deploy; start, seconds both lines stand before it begins; advance, the foot's pace to contact (units a second); contact, the gap between front ranks at blows; overlap, how much of two fronts must face each other across the line before they are at blows (share of their blocks' half widths together; a regiment off to the side closes square on its foe's front first); longest, seconds a battle in play runs (and 120 more) before it is gone whatever is left. volley: seconds between an archer regiment's volleys (low, high), arrows in one (at most: one an archer standing), draw_s (seconds every archer draws together before they loose), step (seconds the loosing spreads over), angle (radians over the flat they loose at) and gravity (world units a second squared: the flight and its arc come from these and the range, a true ballistic arc), spread (world units off the man aimed at, in the target block), men it fells (low, high), and how near the lines may come before archers stop (until). fight: men a regiment in contact loses a second (beaten, victors; the outcome is the realm's, Freeciv's), seconds between a front man's blows (low, high), the chance a front man reels instead (hitOdds) or takes a blow on his shield (blockOdds), ranks that fight, how far the front surges, how much harder a flanked regiment bleeds,. cavalry: ride and charge pace, how far round the enemy's end it swings (wide), how far behind its front it turns in (behind), and the men its charge fells at once where it strikes (shock). loose.most: the arrows in flight at most. camera: the lens's quarter off the lines and how fast it follows; at blows it comes in to close of its distance and looks down pitch degrees (the press fills the frame). field.play: battles in play (scenes.gd stages one where the bridge tells of a battle, always): the lines' middles apart there, men in a regiment for each company that fought, the most companies shown a side, how many such battles at once (more are told, not shown), seconds the field stays held before the living go, aftermath: seasons the fallen and the broken regiments' dropped standards (dropped: their length, units) then lie on the field, kinds: the companies [beaten, victors] of a battle staged where no scene named them (the film's, the shot harness's). field.turns: bearings tried round the crown's muster for the foe's line, the one on the most fit ground taken; ground.*: where a battle may be fought (battlefield): field (how far the fight reaches from its centre), rise (the most the ground may rise or fall across the field), rings (how far out, in rings 0.8 apart, it is looked for), town_clear (how far its edge keeps from a town), farm_clear (its centre from a farmstead, past the field), rough (what each kind of land costs it).

cells._: field_cells.gd, the field as cells, one man a cell (Mac 2026-11-17: 'everything is a cell'; the Battle Orders board): size, a cell's side (world units; every kind of soldier the same); tick, seconds a moment of the rule takes (a man steps a cell a tick); pace, how much faster than a cell a tick his walk goes so he is there in time; shoot, a shooter's reach in cells; troop, the men a troop of a battle draws by its kind (foot 8 in three, three, two: formations.json troop; horse 5 in two, two, one: troop_horse; Mac 2026-11-17: '3-3-2. 8 soldiers per troop. 5 horses in a troop'); packed, the gaps a host starts with (world units: across between troops, between rows; Mac 2026-11-17: 'vertical spacing is too much ... packed better'); reform, once the day is won (Mac 2026-11-17: 'the winning host comes back in formation'): each troop's men in its own template, troops side by side gap cells apart, the shooters' line behind the rest back cells; stride_hold, seconds a man keeps walking past his last step (the beat between steps never stops his legs; Mac 2026-11-17: 'walking isn't happening. we're just gliding').

field._losing: army_field.gd _foe_order: the foe changes his order once his side's men standing fall under losing of the King's; fallback, the order he changes to.

combat._: army_combat.gd, who falls at blows (Total War's melee): blow, the odds one blow of a man at grips fells the man he fights, once a field.cells.tick, for equal kinds, from whichever side he stands (0.104 at 0.26 s: about 2.5 s a kill; Mac 2026-11-17: 'increase the time to kill to 2.5 seconds ... they barely touch and die'); morale: times every blow a side strikes, held between least and most: its men standing over the foe's to power (Mac 2026-11-17: 'if you're the larger force you'll have a better chance'), times its house's heart as the battle begins: its purse over the foe house's to purse, its whole army over the foe's to army, and record a battle for each it won less each it lost among the King's battle cards, held between record_least and record_most ('richness of the house, total army, previous wins, losses'); wind_floor: how hard a troop with no wind still hits (share); wind: stamina a second spent at blows (fight), running (run), won back standing (rest); kinds.<role>: attack, defence (against foot), horse (against a charge), arrows (against arrows).
